name: 404 & Redirects Fixer For SEO Pass
author: MD. THOUHIDUL ISLAM

sections.description:
404 & Redirects Fixer For SEO Pass is a secure, lightweight plugin designed to manage your website’s redirections easily and protect your SEO rankings.

  • Set custom 301 or 302 redirects.
  • Global fallback setting for all 404 errors.
  • Automatically ignores trailing slashes and case sensitivity.
  • Built-in hit counter to track redirected traffic.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “Redirect Manager” menu to configure your redirects.
